headline: Zheng-Dao Swallows Palladian in 14-Hour Hostile Seizure
body: Zheng-Dao finalized its hostile acquisition of Palladian Holdings at 0312 hours this morning, completing a 14-hour blitz of proxy voting, executive displacement, and armed security rotation that financial analysts are calling the most aggressive corponation seizure since the Ferrogate consolidation of 2098. Palladian's board was escorted from the company's Circuit-district headquarters by Zheng-Dao security contractors before dawn, with CEO Margaux Delacroix-Osei issuing a one-line statement through her personal counsel: 'This action is illegitimate and will be contested.' Palladian's core assets — a rare-earth processing network spanning Geartown's lower industrial tier and three subterranean mineral rights corridors in The Underworld — are what analysts believe drove the seizure. Zheng-Dao's materials division has been quietly acquiring leverage positions in Palladian for eleven months. Federal Remnant trade arbiters say they have 'noted the transaction' but stopped short of any intervention. Zheng-Dao spokesperson Tomas Reinholt-Yuen confirmed the acquisition is 'complete and binding under Quanta compact law,' and that Palladian's 4,200 workers will receive employment continuity notices within 72 hours — a claim labor observers are greeting with open skepticism.
aftermath: Palladian's contested assets sparked eighteen months of legal challenges and intermittent armed skirmishes in the Geartown lower tier before Zheng-Dao fully consolidated control in 2119.
runner_relevance: The transition created immediate demand for extraction contracts — Palladian mid-level executives paid top phi to get proprietary R&D files and personal records out of company servers before Zheng-Dao's IT teams locked them down. Simultaneously, Zheng-Dao hired runners for counter-extraction sweeps: find the leaking data, burn the couriers carrying it, and deliver Palladian's internal whistleblower list. The Underworld mineral corridors became contested smuggling routes, with both factions running protection and sabotage contracts for months afterward.
